name: TIP4P/Ice water
source: the paper's Table II; TIP4P's geometry
references: J. L. F. Abascal, E. Sanz, R. Garcia Fernandez, C. Vega, J. Chem. Phys. 122, 234511 (2005)

atom_types.name: MW
atom_types.description: TIP4P/Ice M site (massless, 0.1577 A from O on the bisector)

pairs.name: OW
pairs.comment: O-O Lennard-Jones: q_H 0.5897 e, sigma 3.1668 A, epsilon/k_B 106.1 K, d_OM 0.1577 A, r_OH 0.9572 A, H-O-H 104.52 deg

bonds.name: OW-HW
bonds.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (MacKerell et al. 1998, SI: OT-HT 450.00, HT-OT-HT 55.00) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

angles.name: HW-OW-HW
angles.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (MacKerell et al. 1998, SI: OT-HT 450.00, HT-OT-HT 55.00) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

notes: built by CAPS (bench/ff/make_water_models.py) from the paper's Table II; TIP4P's geometry
rigid model: run it with its bonds and angle constrained (SHAKE / RATTLE in LAMMPS, SETTLE in GROMACS)
